Fact: design_rationale
What to find: How and why key design choices in training were made.
Card sections that often contain it: Training, Design

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card gives rationale for several training choices. WiSE-FT interpolation uses a conservative λ = 0.25, keeping only a quarter of the fine-tuned delta. λ was chosen by constrained optimisation (maximise in-domain score subject to minimal held-out degradation), and this is the direct reason held-out capability survives. Checkpoint fusion averages intermediate SFT checkpoints selected by a diversity probe rather than taking the final checkpoint. MGPO (entropy-weighted GRPO) uses a programmatic verifier with partial credit for loose matches and token-F1 so that all-fail prompt groups still produce gradient. A sibling arm that skipped the conservative interpolation scored higher in-domain but lost about twelve points of held-out capability, so this release is the balanced point of that trade. The macro gate includes rule induction so a fine-tune cannot pass while quietly regressing inductive reasoning.
